vietnamese_pattern: classifier may be omitted or lexicalized
evidence_note: Vietnamese can omit the classifier in natural speech, so 张 needs attention.
Contrast 找 and 找到 before asking learners to translate.
Cognate recognition is not enough for translation.

vietnamese_rendering: Tôi học tiếng Trung ở trường.
evidence_note: Vietnamese often places location after the verb, so the Chinese pre-verbal location frame needs practice.

vietnamese_pattern: Vietnamese tones are a separate system
evidence_note: Vietnamese tone knowledge does not directly map to Mandarin tone marks.
